queries.query: LLM hallucination network configuration misconfiguration "hallucination" OR "incorrect configuration"
queries.rationale: Establish empirical reports and analyses of LLMs producing incorrect or unsafe NetOps outputs (phenomenon).
source_preferences: industry incident reports with verifiable metadata

queries.query: LLM generated network configuration verification "Batfish" OR "VeriFlow" OR "NetPlumber"
queries.rationale: Survey deterministic/network-specific validators used to check LLM-produced configs (mechanisms + mitigations).

queries.query: intent to configuration translation "intent-to-config" "natural language" network configuration synthesis
queries.rationale: Identify prior work mapping operator intent to device configs—direct NetOps task families for study framing.
source_preferences: industrial white papers with reproducible artifacts

queries.query: generate-validate-repair pipeline configuration synthesis "generate-validate-repair" OR "synthesize and verify"
queries.rationale: Collect architectures that combine generation, verification, and repair loops as mitigations to erroneous outputs.
Examine LLMs using external tools/APIs (e.g., network simulators, validators) and orchestration frameworks (mechanisms & mitigations).

queries.query: constrained decoding grammar-based generation network configurations "constrained decoding" "CFG"
queries.rationale: Survey constrained generation techniques (grammar, templates, constrained decoding) to reduce malformed outputs (mitigation).

queries.query: formal verification network configurations reachability loop freedom ACLs "network verification"
queries.rationale: Collect foundational formal-methods work for checking properties (reachability, isolation, loops) used as ground truth validators.

queries.query: benchmarks LLMs networking AIOps "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR "OpsEval" OR "AIOps benchmark"
queries.rationale: Inventory existing benchmark suites and their construction to assess validity and gaps (benchmark validity).

queries.query: evaluation metrics network configuration correctness "reachability" "connectivity" "ACL correctness" "performance"
queries.rationale: Identify precise operational metrics and measurement approaches appropriate for NetOps correctness evaluation (methods).

queries.query: failure modes automated network change "rollout failure" "misconfiguration" "change management"
queries.rationale: Gather literature on operational failure modes and root causes from SRE/NetOps to contextualize LLM-induced failures (phenomenon).

queries.query: prompt injection adversarial prompts network automation "prompt injection" "adversarial" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Survey attack vectors and adversarial inputs that could cause unsafe NetOps actions (security mechanism & threat model).

queries.query: network simulators testbeds Mininet ns-3 GNS3 for config testing "Mininet" "ns-3"
queries.rationale: Catalog emulation/simulation platforms for executing and validating generated configurations experimentally (methods/execution).
Explore HCI and operational workflows combining automated suggestions with human verification (mitigation & deployment model).

queries.query: program synthesis code generation for network device configs "Codex" "CodeBERT" "program synthesis"
queries.rationale: Survey code-generation models and program-synthesis approaches applicable to config generation for mechanistic insight.
source_preferences: engineering blog posts only if linked to primary repo/paper

queries.query: autonomous agents for operations "agentic AI" "autonomous agent" AIOps network management
queries.rationale: Locate neighbouring agentic/agent-based NetOps and AIOps research to position possible agentic architectures and risks.

queries.query: safety trustworthiness frameworks LLMs critical infrastructure "NIST" "safety framework" "trustworthy AI"
queries.rationale: Capture policy, governance, and framework literature for deploying LLMs in critical NetOps contexts (mitigations & requirements).

queries.query: dataset bias synthetic benchmarks networking "dataset bias" "synthetic data" "external validity"
queries.rationale: Assess how dataset construction choices affect benchmark validity and generalizability to production NetOps.

queries.query: evaluation methodology perturbation analysis stress testing LLMs "stress test" "perturbation" "robustness"
queries.rationale: Identify robust experimental designs (paired tests, stress/perturbation analyses) for valid inference about reliability.

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources with verifiable metadata (title, authors, year, venue, DOI/arXiv ID or stable URL).
Peer-reviewed papers or preprints with reproducible artifacts (code/datasets) where possible.
Work directly addressing NetOps/configuration synthesis, verification, or deployment of LLMs/agents in operations.
Tool/project documentation for well-known validators/emulators (Batfish, VeriFlow, Mininet, ns-3) when used as experimental evidence.
Benchmarks and datasets (public repos) relevant to AIOps/NetOps with clear provenance.
exclusion_criteria: Unofficial social-media posts or unverifiable claims without primary-source links.
Proprietary/internal reports inaccessible for verification (unless a public technical report with metadata exists).
Papers unrelated to networking or operationalization of generative models (purely theoretical LLM work with no NetOps connection).
Pre-lock internal development artifacts referenced in the programme (permitted elsewhere but excluded from literature search results used as evidence).
Non-English sources without accessible translations (unless the source is seminal and metadata/verifiable).
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from 2018–2026 to capture modern LLM and agent developments while including earlier foundational networking/formal-verification work (2000s–2017) where seminal (e.g., VeriFlow/NetPlumber papers). Emphasize recent (last 3–5 years) LLM-for-AIOps/NetOps publications and datasets to ensure relevance to current model capabilities.
